gloss: destination address; recipient address; shipping address

definitions.gloss: destination address; recipient address; shipping address
definitions.explanation: The address to which something is being sent — a package, letter, or shipment. The place or person on the receiving end of a delivery.

examples.japanese: {送|おく}り{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{送|おく}り{先|さき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っていた→間違う：03036_machigau⟧。
{送|おく}り{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{発送前|はっそうまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you wish to change the shipping address, please contact us before dispatch.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送|おく}り{先|さき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧にしてほしい。
examples.english: I'd like the delivery destination for this package to be my office, not my home.

notes:
Composed of {送|おく}り (sending, from the verb ⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧) and ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination, place ahead). The ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ suffix is productive in Japanese for indicating the destination or counterpart of an action: {届|とど}け⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (delivery address), ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧ (contact information), ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}→引っ越し先：21647_hikkoshisaki⟧ (place one is moving to).

You will encounter this word when sending packages at the post office or a convenience store, filling out delivery forms (⟦{伝票|でんぴょう}→伝票：07487_denpyou⟧), or shopping online. Japanese delivery slips typically have fields for both {送|おく}り{先|さき} (recipient) and {依頼主|いらいぬし} or {送|おく}り⟦{主|ぬし}→主：30578_nushi⟧ (sender).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送|おく}り{先|さき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: recipient's address
- {送|おく}り{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the shipping address
- {送|おく}り{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to specify the delivery destination
- {送|おく}り{先|さき}⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: address unknown (undeliverable)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {届|とど}け⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: delivery address — a near-synonym, slightly more focused on where something arrives
- ⟦{宛先|あてさき}→宛先：12275_atesaki⟧: addressee, destination — used for letters and emails as well as packages
- ⟦{差出人|さしだしにん}→差出人：06316_sashidashinin⟧: sender — the opposite side of the transaction
